name: Signal Defender
desc: A PCB-themed bullet-hell shooter with six modes, procedurally drawn art, synthesized audio, daily challenges, and local two-player Versus. English/Chinese language toggle and local saves; no external runtime dependencies.
controls: Menus: mouse or tap. Move: WASD, arrow keys, or mouse drag; Shift dash; B EMP bomb; Space/P pause. Mobile: drag to move, second finger or bottom-left button to dash, bottom-right button to bomb. Versus: P1 WASD/Q/E, P2 arrows/Shift/Enter.
creator: Jiacheng Wang
